impl.summary: Image results get a 'Make it 3D (quick)' menu action (after 'Animate with Genjutsu'). It opens /image-to-3d?mode=splat&model=oss-idol&quality=quick&image=<file>, and the studio fills the photo slot, picks Idol 3D on Quick look with the photo crop off, and shows the brief's line (tens of seconds on a consumer GPU). The action only shows when the open engine can run for the owner, so it is hidden on cloud-only installs and for guests and accounts. NEXT_STEPS.image is unchanged. Two commits, pushed to origin/o/idol-5 (base claude/fuobe-parity-4 @ 03e49f2d).

In case 'image' the action is a menu link shown only when ctx.openEngine is set and engineMode is not 'cloud'. Vector pictures, deleted results, videos, audio, text and 3D never get it. docsNotes: FEATURES / STATUS: image results have a 'Make it 3D (quick)' menu action (open engine only). It opens Image to 3D → Splat on Idol 3D's Quick look with the picture in and the photo crop off (on for uploads). It is hidden on 'Paid APIs only' installs, for guests and accounts, and when Idol 3D is switched off. A picture's next-step chips are unchanged.

ARCHITECTURE: ActionContext.openEngine is supplied by the useOpenEngine() hook (src/lib/api.ts), built on openEngineReady (src/lib/connections.ts). Image to 3D links are parsed by readModel3dLink (src/lib/av/model3d.ts): model, mode, quality, image, photo.
New e2e script tests/e2e/make-3d.mjs: node tests/e2e/make-3d.mjs http://localhost:<port> [--shots=dir], with the app in demo mode.

findings.summary: Make it 3D is hidden whenever the open engine can't run, including on 'Paid APIs only' installs and on 'both' installs without ComfyUI, even though fal hosts Idol (idol-3d, MODELS_3D.splat.cloud; docs/research/idol-9.md line 280: 'since 2026-10-30 fal hosts Idol, so a package may add what speridlabs/idol supports on the cloud').
findings.detail: The brief's CLOUD RULE says 'Idol is not hosted', which is out of date; the implementer followed the brief as written, and the package is scoped 'open engine only', so this is not a defect in the build. Under 'each engine does all it can' a later package could offer the action on the cloud as model=idol-3d (hosted, no substitute). Open question for the owner, not a blocker.

Security: readModel3dLink accepts only /api/files/ or https:// up to 2048 chars (stricter than other studios' ?image=). An https input is fetched server-side only through fetchRemote (public links only) in src/server/storage.ts, and guardRef refuses links inside a tenant. No SSRF or path-traversal regression.

Studio state: modeOf('oss-idol') resolves to splat/open; quality is stored under the same `${mode}:${engine}` key idolQuality reads; fromImage sets the slot with source 'generation' (photo crop off) or 'upload' with ?photo=1. UrlModel's effect now depends on params instead of id/mode strings; useSearchParams is stable for an unchanged URL and setEngine only changes with the engine mode, so it does not re-fill the slot after the user changes it. pickMode's router.replace drops ?image=, so no re-fill on a mode change.

fix.finalSummary: idol-5 is finished. Image results have a 'Make it 3D (quick)' menu action right after Genjutsu. It opens Image to 3D, Splat, on Idol 3D (oss-idol), Quick look, with the picture in the slot, the photo crop off (on for uploads) and the brief's copy shown. One press of 'Make the splat' runs it. Open engine: built, and verified in demo mode only. A real Idol run needs the owner's ComfyUI or GPU with Idol installed (from idol-1); nothing here was run on a GPU. Cloud engine: the action is hidden on 'Paid APIs only' installs and whenever the open engine can't run, as the brief says. Hosted Idol (idol-3d on fal) stays available in the studio itself and needs a fal key. The action also hides when Idol 3D is switched off for open in Settings → Models & licences. Guests and accounts never see the action (openEngineReady is false for any viewer), and 3D runs stay closed to accounts on the server (own-gpu-tool). No new route, migration, graph or node pack. This fix stage moved the Idol switch and the studio's link hand-over into pure, tested helpers and fixed a misplaced doc comment.

The optional one-click go=<token> auto-run for /image-to-3d is not built. The user presses 'Make the splat' once.
No real GPU run of Idol was checked; only demo mode was verified.
